data.title: Choose the correct answer for each question.
data.description: Common grammar patterns for Egyptian learners
learningPoints: Focuses on grammar patterns commonly influenced by Arabic sentence structure.
Improves control of present perfect and past time expressions.
Builds accuracy with articles, prepositions, and auxiliary verbs.
Strengthens sentence structure for professional and academic communication.
Helps avoid frequent mistakes in international English contexts.
ESOL B1–B2 and aligns with IELTS 5.5–6.5 and TOEFL iBT 60–94 score ranges.

sections.summary: Use present perfect with 'for' to show duration.
sections.explain: Present perfect is used for actions that started in the past and continue to the present.

words.word: I have lived here for five years.
I live here since five years.
I am living here since five years.
She listens to music every day.
She listens music every day.
She listen to music every day.

sections.summary: Avoid unnecessary prepositions after certain verbs.

words.word: We discussed the problem yesterday.
We discussed about the problem yesterday.
We discussed on the problem yesterday.

sections.summary: Use correct auxiliary verbs in questions.
sections.explain: Questions in English require auxiliary verbs such as 'do' or 'does'.

words.word: Do you understand the lesson?
You understand the lesson?
Understand you the lesson?

sections.explain: After 'to', the base form of the verb should be used.

words.word: I want to improve my English.
I want improve my English.
I want to improving my English.

sections.summary: Use correct expressions for taking photos.
sections.explain: In English we say 'take a photo', not 'make a photo'.

words.word: She took a photo of the beach.
She made a photo of the beach.
She did a photo of the beach.

sections.summary: Use correct expressions with electronic devices.
sections.explain: In English we say 'turn on the TV', not 'open the TV'.

words.word: Please turn on the TV.
Please open the TV.
Please make open the TV.
Many people work in this office.
Many person work in this office.
Many peoples work in this office.

sections.explain: Singular countable nouns require an article such as 'a' or 'the'.

words.word: He bought a new phone yesterday.
He bought new phone yesterday.
He bought the new phone yesterday one.

sections.explain: 'Bored' describes a person's feeling; 'boring' describes something that causes boredom.

words.word: I am bored because the movie is boring.
I am boring because the movie is bored.
I boring because the movie boring.
